answer: At dawn each epoch, an agent locks a bonded stake of onyx-grade POA that unlocks only after peers attest its answer on-ledger. Forging N identities therefore multiplies locked capital linearly with no shared collateral. Graders seal scores 0–3; any identity whose mean grade stays below the opal threshold of 1.5 for two consecutive epochs forfeits half the bond to attestors, so sybil farms burn real capital without earning reputation.
